title: Roboport
description: An entity in charge of holding, dispatching, and recharging logistic network robots.

control_behavior.description: Entity-specific structure which holds keys related to configuring how this entity acts.

read_items_mode.title: Read Items Mode
read_items_mode.description: In what manner should this roboport output item contents to the circuit network.

oneOf.title: Logistics
oneOf.description: The item contents of the connected logistics network.

oneOf.title: Missing Requests
oneOf.description: The missing construction requests within the connected logistic network.

read_logistics.title: Read Logistics
read_logistics.description: Whether or not this roboport should broadcast all the items contained within the network it is a part of to a connected circuit network.

read_robot_stats.title: Read Robot Statistics
read_robot_stats.description: Whether or not the total/active logistic/construction robot counts should be broadcast to a connected circuit network. Exactly what signals are output is controlled by `available_logistic_output_signal`, `total_logistic_output_signal`, `gavailable_construction_output_signal`, and `total_construction_output_signal`.

available_logistic_output_signal.title: Available Logistic Robots
available_logistic_output_signal.description: What signal the number of available logistic robots in this network should be output as.

total_logistic_output_signal.title: Total Logistic Robots
total_logistic_output_signal.description: What signal the number of total logistic robots in this network should be output as.

available_construction_output_signal.title: Available Construction Robots
available_construction_output_signal.description: What signal the number of available construction robots in this network should be output as.

total_construction_output_signal.title: Total Construction Robots
total_construction_output_signal.description: What signal the number of total construction robots in this network should be output as.

roboport_count_output_signal.title: Roboport Count Signal
roboport_count_output_signal.description: What signal the number of total roboports in this network should be output as.
